title: Oracle Fusion Data Intelligence (FDI) Developer
jobDescription: Job Description Role Summary We are looking for a Senior Oracle Fusion Data Intelligence (FDI) Developer to design, build and maintain analytics content on the Oracle Fusion Data Intelligence platform (formerly Fusion Analytics Warehouse). The role focuses on delivering actionable reporting and dashboards for Finance/ERP and Supply Chain (SCM) stakeholders. The successful candidate will extend Oracle's prebuilt ERP and SCM analytics with custom subject areas, KPIs and data augmentations, integrate external data sources, and ensure data quality, performance and security across the platform. This is a hands-on senior position that also involves mentoring, stakeholder engagement and technical ownership of the FDI environment. Key Responsibilities • Design and build custom dashboards, workbooks, KPIs and analytic cards on Oracle Fusion Data Intelligence (FDI/FAW) for ERP and SCM domains. • Extend Oracle's prebuilt ERP Analytics and SCM Analytics content — build custom subject areas and semantic model extensions to meet business needs. • Model and enrich data using Data Augmentation and Custom Data Configurations, sourcing from Oracle Fusion Cloud applications and external systems. • Configure and maintain data pipelines (functional and external), monitor refresh schedules, and troubleshoot data load and reconciliation issues. • Implement role-based and data-level (row-level) security, security assignments and content access in line with governance requirements. • Optimize dashboards and semantic models for performance, and ensure data accuracy across Financials (GL, AP, AR, FA, Costing) and SCM (Inventory, Procurement, Order Management, Manufacturing). • Produce technical documentation, promote content across environments, and support release and change-management processes. Job Requirements Required Qualifications Proficiency with the Oracle Fusion Data Intelligence (FDI) tool itself is the core competency for this role and is mandatory. The items below establish the required senior baseline; candidates without proven, hands-on delivery experience will not be considered. Demonstrated proficiency with Oracle Fusion Data Intelligence (FDI) as a core competency — the candidate must be able to build and extend analytics content directly on the FDI platform (custom subject areas, KPIs, cards, dashboards, Data Augmentation and semantic model extensions). Substantial hands-on experience in BI / data warehouse / analytics development at a senior level. This is a senior position; extensive, demonstrable delivery experience is essential and applicants without it will not be considered. Advanced SQL and PL/SQL; solid data modeling and dimensional (star-schema) design skills. Understanding of data-level and role-based security models within Fusion analytics. Strong analytical, troubleshooting and requirements-gathering ability with Finance and SCM stakeholders. Advantageous Skills and Experience The following are not mandatory, but are considered strong advantages. Together they enable the developer to deliver comprehensive FDI analytics solutions that leverage both foundational and contemporary Oracle analytics technologies: Hands-on experience with the Supply Chain Management (SCM) and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) modules within FDI — a major advantage and highly relevant to this role. Knowledge of Oracle Transactional Business Intelligence (OTBI) integration — a significant advantage, given OTBI's role in providing real-time data into FDI. Understanding of the Fusion ERP and SCM database schemas and their underlying table structures — a substantial advantage that allows the developer to work effectively with the data. Prior experience with Oracle Business Intelligence Enterprise Edition (OBIEE), the on-premise Oracle analytics platform — a major advantage that provides valuable foundational business-intelligence expertise. Understanding of Business Intelligence Cloud Connector (BICC) extracts and the associated ETL processes for extracting and loading data from Fusion Cloud Applications — an important advantage for data-pipeline implementation. Additional Preferred Qualifications Oracle certifications in FDI / Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC) or Autonomous Data Warehouse (ADW). Experience with Oracle Autonomous Data Warehouse (ADW) and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Scripting experience (e.g. Python) and familiarity with Git/version control and CI/CD for analytics content. Prior experience in a manufacturing, supply-chain or technology organization. Technical Skills Snapshot Platforms & Tools: Oracle Fusion Data Intelligence (FDI/FAW), Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC), Oracle Autonomous Data Warehouse (ADW), Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Data & Development: SQL, PL/SQL, dimensional data modeling, semantic modeling, Data Augmentation, custom subject areas, data pipelines. Domain: Oracle Fusion ERP/Financials (GL, AP, AR, FA, Costing) and SCM (Inventory, Procurement, Order Management, Manufacturing). Reporting & Integration: OTBI (real-time reporting into FDI), OBIEE (on-premise foundation), BICC extracts and ETL processes. See all open positions How can we help you? Cloud Integration: Deploy and manage applications on Azure Cloud/ AWS, and utilize CI/CD pipelines for version control and automated testing. title: Head of IT – India (Oracle)
jobDescription: Job Description Location: India Department: Information Technology Reports to: VP, Applications (HQ) Matrix Reporting: Head of India Role Overview The Head of IT – India will serve as the senior IT leader for the India site, acting as the primary liaison between local management and the global IT organization. This role is responsible for managing the on-site IT team, overseeing daily IT operations, ensuring high-quality end-user support, and leading the local development (delivery) team. A critical aspect of this position is extensive expertise in Oracle ERP (Fusion), including the ability to guide, support, and manage teams working on Oracle-related development, configuration, integration, and support activities. The Head of IT – India will collaborate closely with HQ on the Oracle roadmap, participate in IT recruitment, and lead various ad hoc IT projects as assigned by HQ. Key Responsibilities Leadership & Management Manage and mentor the local IT team in India, including infrastructure, support, and development personnel. Oversee, guide, and support teams working on Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, ensuring alignment with HQ architecture, processes, and standards. Function effectively within a matrixed organizational structure, maintaining alignment with functional managers in HQ. Act as the primary IT business partner for India site leadership. IT Operations & Support Oversee on-site IT activities to ensure smooth operations and high service levels. Ensure compliance with global IT standards, governance, and security policies. Drive continuous improvement in system stability, process quality, and support efficiency. Oracle ERP (Fusion) Leadership Serve as the senior local expert and focal point for Oracle ERP Fusion matters. Provide guidance on functional and technical aspects of Oracle modules used by the organization. Lead or support Oracle-related development and integration initiatives executed by the India development/delivery team. Coordinate with HQ’s Oracle ERP leadership to ensure local activities align with global strategy and timelines. Application Development & Delivery Lead the local development/delivery team supporting software development, application enhancements, and Oracle ERP integrations. Manage work plans, priorities, and performance in coordination with HQ application managers. Ensure on-time, high-quality delivery according to the global IT roadmap. Recruitment & Team Growth Participate in hiring IT roles in India, including Oracle ERP developers/consultants, infrastructure engineers, and support staff. Support onboarding, mentoring, and skill development of Oracle-focused team members. Stakeholder Management Serve as the central IT point of contact for India site management and HQ IT teams. Facilitate clear communication between India IT teams and global IT departments. Act as the escalation point for IT incidents or Oracle system challenges. Project Leadership Lead ad hoc projects initiated by HQ, including system implementations, Oracle enhancements, integrations, infrastructure initiatives, and IT transformation programs. Provide regular updates to HQ on project progress, risks, and deliverables. Qualifications & Experience Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field. 15+ years of progressive IT experience, with at least 4 years in a managerial position. Strong, hands-on experience with Oracle ERP Cloud (Fusion), including modules such as Finance, Procurement, SCM, or others used by the organization. Proven experience leading Oracle ERP teams (developers, consultants, analysts). Experience supporting or implementing ERP solutions in a global or multinational environment. Strong communication skills and stakeholder-management capabilities. Experience leading teams in a matrixed environment. Solid understanding of IT operations, infrastructure, and application development workflows. Experience working with global IT organizations across multiple countries. Familiarity with Oracle integration technologies (OIC, REST APIs, Paa S). Project management experience (Agile, PMP, or equivalent).
